app.name: jcabi-github
app.one_liner: A Java object-oriented wrapper for the GitHub REST API with built-in fake server support for isolated testing.

screens.name: GitHub API Interaction Console
screens.purpose: Demonstrate core GitHub operations like creating repos, issues, and comments using the jcabi-github OOP API.

rust_commands.name: configure_custom_github
rust_commands.purpose: Configure connection to a self-hosted GitHub instance using a custom URI.

rust_commands.name: create_issue
rust_commands.purpose: Create a new GitHub issue in a specified repository using the jcabi-github API.

rust_commands.name: post_comment
rust_commands.purpose: Post a comment to an existing GitHub issue via the jcabi-github object interface.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build fake GitHub server for offline testing
week 1: Create basic issue and comment interaction commands
week 1: Implement RtGitHub wrapper with OAuth and URI constructors
acceptance_tests: Failing tests are removed or refactored during maintenance without breaking core functionality.
User can connect to a custom GitHub instance (e.g., https://github.mydomain.com) via URI configuration.
User can create a GitHub issue using valid OAuth token and default API endpoint.
User can post a comment to an existing issue without network calls by using fake GitHub server.
